items.imagePrompt: Simple educational flashcard illustration of exactly one tree. Plain and minimal: brown trunk, soft green leafy canopy, clean flat shapes, soft cream background, centered. Kid-friendly and clear, cute but NOT anthropomorphic. No face, no eyes, no mouth, no cheeks, no expression on the tree or any object. No extra clutter. Strictly no text, no letters, no words, no labels, no watermark. Match the simplicity of an approved vocabulary flashcard icon.
